drafts.subject: Melbourne maker, for when a build needs more character
drafts.body:
Burst runs branding, signage production and activations under one roof. That is rarer than it sounds; most agencies have to send the making somewhere else.

I'm Oddtoe, a Melbourne studio that designs and fabricates. Character and prop work, kinetic and public sculpture, projection, and the occasional sensory garden. Twenty years of illustration sits underneath it, so the odd ideas turn up already drawn.

My delivered public piece is Babbling with Baobabs, made for Signal and the City of Melbourne at the 2019 Comedy Festival.

If a client ever wants something characterful that your signage line isn't shaped for, I'd be a useful call. Short guide to what I make:
https://www.oddtoe.com/experiential-marketing-agencies/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=outreach&utm_content=b7b32e82-8bc4-459a-9ccb-9933cec1849e

If you'd rather not hear from me, just reply ‘no thanks’ and I won't contact you again.

Oddtoe — Otto Ottinger
oddtoe@oddtoe.com

Your work runs from brand activations to public events and exhibitions, with Melbourne on the list alongside Sydney.

I'm Oddtoe, a Melbourne studio working across experiential design and public art. I design and fabricate both: character and prop work, kinetic and public sculpture, projection, installation. Twenty years of illustration underneath it, which is usually what makes a piece worth photographing.

Delivered public work: Babbling with Baobabs, commissioned for Signal by the City of Melbourne for the 2019 Comedy Festival.
